facts.conditions: VO nominal (typ); guaranteed min 11.5 / max 12.5 V at TJ = 25 degC under the Table 15 header conditions VI = 19 V, IO = 500 mA, CI = 0.33 uF, CO = 0.1 uF

VO over the full guarantee band: IO = 5 mA to 1 A AND VI = 14.5 to 25 V, TJ = 0 to 125 degC. ST guarantees regulation only inside this band: nothing is guaranteed below VI = 14.5 V or above IO = 1 A - the project operating point (13.5 V in, 1.2 A) is outside both limits
facts.locator: src-l7812cd2t-ds0422-elec: Table 15, row VO (IO = 5 mA to 1 A, VI = 14.5 to 25 V)

facts.conditions: Vd dropout voltage, IO = 1 A, TJ = 25 degC; TYPICAL ONLY - Table 15 gives no min and no max dropout at any current, so ST guarantees no dropout limit anywhere for L7812C

dropout at IO = 1.2 A (the project +12 V rail rating): DS0422 Table 15 provides no dropout figure at 1.2 A and no guaranteed dropout at any current; the nearest datasheet point is 2 V typ at IO = 1 A, TJ = 25 degC; dropout rises with current and falls with temperature, so the 1.2 A / warm-board value can only be closed on the bench
facts.locator: src-l7812cd2t-ds0422-elec: Table 15, row Vd (absence of any 1.2 A or guaranteed-limit entry)

facts.conditions: available input-output headroom at the project operating point: 13.5 V rail minus 12.0 V nominal output.
